title: 治験薬サプライチェーン担当者 / Investigational Drug Supply Chain Specialist
description:
職務内容：
募集背景： 中外製薬は自社の革新的創薬技術に加え、ロシュグループの豊富なパイプラインを有しており、多くの治験が実施中です。 治験実施には「治験薬の計画的・安定的供給」が不可欠であり、この責任者を担う治験薬サプライチェーン担当者は臨床開発Study team memberの一員として大変重要な役割を担っています。 近年、治験数の増加やモダリティの多様化への対応等、最適なプロセスの再構築・E2Eのシステム導入にも取り組んでおり、治験薬供給および関連プロセスの改善活動に貢献できる即戦力となりえる人財を求めています。 仕事内容： ・治験薬サプライ機能としてE2E（中間体・原薬・製剤製造拠点、包装・国内外配送デポ・治験実施医療機関）を通じ、立案した供給計画に基づき、CMC/臨床機能関係者、海外拠点や国内外CMOと協力しながら、供給を構築・推進し、On-Time In-Full供給を実現する。また、それに関わるサプライチェーンシステムを運用する。 ・バルク包装以降の供給計画を治験薬開発計画や臨床機能からの所要計画に基づき立案し、治験薬ラベル文書を執筆、供給に関する情報を臨床開発Study teamに提供する。 ・CMOへの発注・基本契約締結、輸送・輸出入、保管デポ入庫、有効期限延長・短縮、異常逸脱、未使用治験薬の廃棄、リコール、監査等の対応、予算・請求書支払い、CMO・デポのオーバーサイト等の周辺業務を行う。 ・最新の規制や業界のベストプラクティスの入手に努め、治験薬サプライ業務プロセスの最速かつ最適な再構築提案を行い、臨床開発スケジュール・コストへの貢献を図る。 職種の魅力： 自社およびロシュの豊富な開発パイプライン、新たなモダリティ等があり、多種多様な治験薬管理の経験を得ることができ本領域における専門性スキルの向上が期待できます。 ロシュや海外拠点の治験薬担当と連携し、グローバルレベルな治験薬マネジメント業務をリードすることで治験推進に貢献できます。 First in class、Best in classの薬剤開発に貢献でき、新薬承認、世界の健康に貢献できることで社会への貢献を実感できます。 ---- Background to recruitment: In addition to its own innovative drug discovery technologies, Chugai Pharmaceutical has access to the Roche Group's extensive pipeline and is conducting numerous clinical trials. The planned and stable supply of investigational medicinal products is essential to conducting clinical trials. The investigational drug supply chain specialist responsible for this work plays a critical role as a member of the clinical development study team. In recent years, we have also been redesigning optimal processes and implementing end-to-end systems to respond to the growing number of clinical trials and the diversification of modalities. We are seeking an experienced professional who can make an immediate contribution to investigational drug supply and related process improvement initiatives. Description of work: ・As part of the investigational drug supply function, establish and manage end-to-end supplyーfrom intermediate, drug substance, and drug product manufacturing sites through packaging, domestic and international distribution depots, and clinical trial sitesーin accordance with established supply plans. Collaborate with CMC and clinical stakeholders, overseas sites, and domestic and international CMOs to achieve On-Time In-Full delivery, and operate the related supply chain systems. ・Develop supply plans from bulk packaging onward based on investigational drug development plans and demand forecasts provided by clinical functions; prepare investigational drug labeling documentation; and provide supply-related information to clinical development study teams. ・Manage related activities, including placing orders with CMOs, executing master agreements, transportation, import/export, receipt at storage depots, shelf-life extensions and reductions, deviations, disposal of unused investigational drugs, recalls, audits, budget and invoice payments, and oversight of CMOs and depots. ・Stay current with the latest regulations and industry best practices; propose the fastest and most effective redesign of investigational drug supply processes; and contribute to clinical development timelines and cost optimization. Position Features: With Chugai's and Roche's extensive development pipelines and emerging modalities, you will gain experience managing a wide variety of investigational medicinal products and have opportunities to deepen your expertise in this field. By collaborating with investigational drug supply teams at Roche and other overseas sites and leading global investigational drug management activities, you can contribute directly to the advancement of clinical trials. You will also help develop first-in-class and best-in-class medicines and experience the fulfillment of contributing to new drug approvals and better health worldwide.
応募資格( 経験/資格など )：
求める経験： ・CMC開発、臨床開発（製薬企業、CRO）、CMOいずれかの経験があることが望ましい ・複数の治験プロジェクトもしくは大型プロジェクトを担当し、業務を完遂した経験 ・自部門内外の複数部署、社外の外部のステークホルダーと協働し、プロジェクトを代表して交渉・折衝を行った経験 【さらに以下の経験や実績があると尚可】 ・臨床試験計画に従った治験薬必要量の計画策定経験 ・治験薬サプライ業界情報、治験薬関連のVendor等の豊富な知識 求めるスキル・知識・能力： ・治験薬サプライ関連のGMP、GCP、GDPを含む国内外規制を理解し、自らの業務に落とし込んで説明できる方 ・担当業務を適切な時期に確実に実行し、関係者と円滑に業務を遂行することができる方 ・トラブルに対し、迅速かつ能動的に良好な関係構築を築きながら本質的なポイントを抑え、効果的な改善策・課題解決の立案・実行を行うことができる方 ・課題に対する論理構築力とコミュニケーション能力。さらにその内容を相手にわかりやすく説明できる言語化、プレゼンテーション能力 求める行動特性： ・患者さん目線で行動できる チームおよび個人の目標へのコミット意識が高く、目標達成に向けて困難があっても遂行責任を負って粘り強く邁進し自走することができる ・高い倫理観を持ち、常に誠実な行動で様々な社内外ステークホルダーと友好的な協力関係を築き、互いのWin-Winを常に意識し、課題抽出、解決策を立案・実行できる ・新たな取り組みに積極的に参加し、挑戦する 必須資格： ・英語でのビジネスコミュニケーションが可能な方（TOEIC 730点以上程度） ----- Desired experience: ・Experience in CMC development, clinical development (at a pharmaceutical company or CRO), or CMO operations is preferred. ・Experience successfully managing multiple clinical trial projects or a large-scale project through completion. ・Experience collaborating with multiple internal departments and external stakeholders, and negotiating on behalf of a project. [The following experience and achievements are additionally preferred] ・Experience planning investigational drug requirements in accordance with clinical trial plans. ・Extensive knowledge of the investigational drug supply industry and related vendors. Preferred Knowledge and Skills: ・Ability to understand domestic and international regulations related to investigational drug supply, including GMP, GCP, and GDP, apply them to your work, and explain their practical implications. ・Ability to execute assigned responsibilities reliably and at the appropriate time while working smoothly with stakeholders. ・Ability to respond to problems quickly and proactively, identify the essential issues while building positive relationships, and develop and implement effective improvements and solutions. ・Logical thinking and communication skills for addressing business challenges, along with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and present them in an easy-to-understand manner. Desired competencies: ・Ability to act from a patient-centered perspective. ・Strong commitment to team and individual goals, with the ability to take ownership, persevere through difficulties, and work autonomously toward achieving objectives. ・High ethical standards and integrity; ability to build cooperative relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders, maintain a win-win mindset, identify issues, and develop and implement solutions. ・Actively participate in and embrace new initiatives and challenges. Desired Qualification: ・Ability to communicate effectively in English in a business environment (approximately TOEIC 730 or above). ・Japanese Language Proficiency Test Level N2 or above, or equivalent Japanese language ability
待遇：
フレックスタイム制（コアタイムなし） Flextime system 当社規定により優遇いたします。 労働条件の通知は電子ファイルによって行います。ご応募される場合は、その点につきご了承ください。 To be decided in accordance with our criteria. The notification of working conditions will be made in an electronic file. If you apply, please understand this point.
勤務地：
浮間研究所（東京都北区）/ Ukima Research Laboratories (Kita Ward, Tokyo) 事業所内禁煙 就業時間内禁煙（※） ※休憩時間及び就業時間外は除く

title: Associate Director, Site Supply Chain
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

High-level Description (including manage team/individuals or not)As a member of the Aichi Plant Leadership Team, responsible for formulating and executing strategy. As the leader of the Supply Chain Management Department, reliably grasps changes both inside and outside the plant and contributes effectively to plant management decisions by maintaining a cross-functional, plant-wide perspective.
Aiming to improve customer service and optimize the utilization of Aichi Plant production resources (equipment and personnel), provides guidance and development to section members and across departments, and practices the personnel management required for business execution and the maintenance/improvement of GMP-compliant production management.
In policy decisions and business execution, communicates closely with overseas headquarters, the Global Supply Chain Management function, and related BMS Japan departments to make the best and most timely decisions. Promotes the deployment of globally-rolled-out processes and systems, ensuring smooth collaboration as part of the global supply chain. Leads necessary discussions and negotiations with the global team based on a clear understanding of the Aichi Plant's situation and advantages.
Responsible for Aichi Plant warehouse management; maintains lean, waste-free production through close collaboration with the Inspection & Packaging team, and leads continuous improvement of operations.
Proposes optimal budgets and projections related to production and procurement planning from cost and cash perspectives, and obtains approval from the Aichi Plant GM. After approval, manages and reports whether execution is proceeding appropriately against budget, and drives continuous improvement by involving departments both inside and outside the plant. In connection with procurement operations, makes required reports to relevant government agencies, and is also responsible for handling interactions with regulatory authorities such as Customs and the Small and Medium Enterprise Agency, ensuring compliance with laws and regulations.
Owns the Aichi Plant's Business Continuity Management (BCM) process. Effectively engages relevant departments both inside and outside the plant to drive discussion, surface risks, and lead risk mitigation.
As Site Data Lead, responsible for the quality and ongoing management of supply-chain-related data at the Aichi Plant, and facilitates the Site Data Governance Board. Additionally, leads digitalization and effective use of AI to make supply chain management operations more efficient and effective.

Roles & Responsibilities
Carries out the roles below by exercising independent managerial judgment while obtaining approval and advice from the Plant GM and global supply chain stakeholders. Personally handles production planning and progress management, while building deep teamwork and collaboration with the import and procurement functions. For some tasks, may also be expected to guide temporary staff and fixed-term employees in carrying out the work.
Measurement, management, and reporting of Supply Chain and Delivery-related metricsMeasures, manages, and reports metrics established by Global as well as plant-wide indicators used to drive continuous improvement.
Conducts root-cause analysis for metrics that fall short of targets, and leads improvement activities by involving other departments.

Talent developmentDevelops section members and manages their performance.
Contributes to discussions on the Aichi Plant talent pipeline, and is also responsible for talent development beyond own section.

Production plan creation and progress managementCreates appropriate production plans based on the sales plan, ensuring safety stock while avoiding excess inventory.
Confirms with the procurement team any discrepancies between the DP delivery plan and actual import timing, escalating and proposing countermeasures as needed.
Hosts regular meetings with overseas related departments to drive continuous improvement.
Manages progress against the production plan. When delays occur, forecasts their impact and formulates countermeasures to avoid disruption to product supply.

Creation of material and intermediate-product purchasing plans, ordering, and delivery-date managementCreates purchasing plans for production materials and import plans for intermediate products based on the production plan.
For imports of intermediate products requiring large amounts of working capital, provides medium-term import plans to the Finance department.
Manages deliveries to ensure they occur as ordered and prevents delivery delays; if a delay does occur, takes measures to minimize its impact.
Manages payment of purchase amounts and oversees the process to ensure no payment delays occur that would violate laws such as the Subcontract Act.
Consults with responsible departments and places orders for plant fixed assets, general expense items, etc.

Vendor selection and vendor managementConsults with related departments to select the most suitable vendor when determining new vendors.
Continually pursues cost reduction and cash improvement through price negotiations with vendors.
Executes contracts with vendors.
Regularly manages and improves vendor performance.

Site Data LeadResponsible for the quality (Completeness, Accuracy, Consistency, Timeliness) of SC-related data at the Aichi Plant and its ongoing management.
Convenes the SC Lead, Local Data Owner, and each function to hold the monthly Site Data Governance Board, strengthening Data Governance at the Aichi Plant. (Reviews data accuracy results for the site, action plans, ownership, issues, and resources.)
Participates in the bi-weekly SDL Bi-Weekly Meeting, sharing performance reviews and the status of issue resolution, and escalates issues for resolution as needed.

Warehouse operations managementAchieves lean, waste-free production through collaboration with Inspection & Packaging, QC, and suppliers, and leads continuous improvement of operations.

Ownership of the Business Continuity Management (BCM) processEffectively engages relevant departments both inside and outside the plant to drive discussion, and leads risk surfacing and mitigation.

Change managementWhen changes to materials or other items arise due to regulatory notices or other reasons, formulates a change plan that can be implemented in compliance with laws and other regulations, and manages progress against the schedule.

New product launch preparationParticipates in the project team for new product launches and formulates appropriate production plans, etc.
Participates in project teams with overseas related departments for new product launches.

Budget and projection creationPrepares budget proposals for production volume, intermediate-product inventory, planned material purchases, etc., and obtains approval from the Plant GM.
Creates updated projections for these items at times instructed by the company, and obtains approval from the Plant GM.
After approval, continuously manages progress and operates within budget.

Inventory planning and managementFormulates appropriate inventory plans covering everything from materials to finished products, based on the sales plan, ensuring safety stock while preventing excess inventory.
Continuously monitors inventory status and reports regularly using the global reporting system.

Other related dutiesCreates and updates procedures for production management and intermediate-product inventory management, and obtains approval from the Plant GM.
Maintains SAP master data related to planning operations.
Identifies issues within and outside the section, proactively participates in improvement activities, and improves operations by engaging section members.
Participates in BMS Japan crisis management meetings, and formulates and implements measures to minimize adverse impact in the event of an emergency.
Attends regulatory inspections and audits within own area of responsibility, formulates improvement measures for findings, and leads section members in implementing them.

Required Knowledge / Skills
Range of knowledge/skills/experience required and degree/depth/scope of communication (including language skill)/collaboration.Knowledge and experience in management decision-making, strategy formulation, and execution, as required of a member of the plant's leadership team
Knowledge of products, manufacturing processes, and quality control processes(5+ years of experience at manufacturing site)
Knowledge of production planning methods, inventory management methods, etc. (5+ years of practical experience at manufacturing site)
Knowledge of manufacturing cost, and experience of budget
Knowledge of the Act on Securing Quality, Efficacy and Safety of Products Including Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices (formerly the Pharmaceutical Affairs Law)
Advanced SAP operating skills
Problem-solving ability to respond to issues such as troubles/incidents
Negotiation and communication skills to collaborate effectively with headquarters and in-plant related departments, especially the global supply chain team
English proficiency sufficient to hold discussions with overseas related departments (minimum OPA score of 8.0)
Communication and presentation skills sufficient to give the other party a clear understanding of one's area of expertise
High ability to build teamwork
Ability to give accurate work instructions to temporary staff
Holds, or has the ability to obtain, CSCP (Certified Supply Chain Professional) certification

title: Medical Oncology Head
description:
Job Description Summary

-Lead global medical affairs team for compound(s) of responsibility and represent GMA at GPT or lead region or country TA medical team and represent TA in global teams. Drive global medical plan & disease are strategy, action plan & execution of medical activities or co-own Medical Affairs plan/co-lead the medical franchise strategy for region or country roles. Provide medical leadership in cross-functional teams to support integrated disease area plans or drive execution of country Medical Affairs activities.
 

Job Description

The Medical TA Head defines and executes the country-specific medical strategy for the assigned Therapeutic Area, ensuring aligned and impactful delivery of scientific engagement, medical education, evidence generation, and cross‑functional support. The role serves as the country’s scientific leader for the TA, shaping strategy, guiding external customer and field engagement, and ensuring high scientific standards across all medical activities throughout the product lifecycle.

Medical TA Strategy

Adapt international medical plans into a country tailored Medical TA strategy supporting prelaunch, launch and lifecycle management.
Build a strategic orientation and tactical plans across external insights, medical education, and publication planning.
Set and oversee the local data generation strategy (RWE, HEOR inputs, evidence generation, Phase IV/IIIb) including publication plans.
Provide scientific and clinical expertise to inform trial design, feasibility, integrated evidence strategies, and local clinical programs.
Serve as the disease area expert for internal stakeholders (Marketing, Market Access, Regulatory, Commercial, Digital).
Guarantee ERC/compliance in all medical activities and materials.
 

Medical Engagement

Lead and guide all peer-to-peer scientific exchange with HCPs and Medical Experts (MEs) to ensure credible, unbiased, scientific dialogue.
Oversee MSL strategic direction, ensuring coherent field engagement plans aligned to TA strategy.
Ensure systematic external insight gathering and translate insights into strategic recommendations.
Support internal teams with medical knowledge, clinical data interpretation, and training.
Ensure medical teams maintain highest standards in evidence based, ethical engagement.
 

Medical Education & Scientific Communication

Design and execute the medical education strategy, including scientific events, symposia, hospital meetings, and congress activities.
Localize and produce high quality scientific communication materials (presentations, publications, external education tools).
Partner with Medical Customer Excellence and other internal functions on external scientific event planning, vendor management, congress measurement and reporting.
Lead or support publication planning for the country TA.
Provide scientific inputs to EE Capability Building to design/localize capability programs/curricula for medical teams and for TA teams and partner for the delivery of those.
 

Medical Partnerships

Build and maintain strong partnerships with Medical Experts, scientific societies, and academic institutions to support collaboration and scientific leadership in the TA.
Partner cross-functionally with Commercial TA Heads, Value & Access, Regulatory, Execution Excellence and global/international/regional medical teams.
Represent the company as the credible scientific ambassador in the TA, contributing to a positive reputation with key stakeholders and institutions.
Strengthen the medical ecosystem by shaping joint value creation initiatives, evidence based collaborations, and multistakeholder partnerships.
 

Leadership & Culture

•        Foster an engaged, high-performance culture with clear goals, coaching, and ongoing development.

•        Attract future ready talents, help them grow, and keep them engaged; strengthen succession and capability across the country organization.

•        Lead by example with Novartis Leadership Expectations, encouraging transformation, strong performance, and a growth mindset.

Ideal Background 

Experiences:

7+ years in Medical Affairs and/or Clinical Development
Experience working in Oncology Therapeutic Area 
Proven track record in developing and executing medical strategies across the product lifecycle.
Prior leadership experiences.
Experience in scientific engagement with Medical Experts/HCPs and guiding MSL/field medical teams.
Demonstrated experience in evidence generation, publication planning, and interpreting clinical data.
Cross‑functional collaboration experience with Market Access, Regulatory, Marketing, Commercial.
Experience leading medical education programs, congress activities, and external scientific events.
Exposure to regional/global medical functions with ability to translate strategy into local action.

Ability to design and deliver country specific medical strategies, translating global direction into local execution.
Strong scientific expertise with ability to interpret and communicate complex clinical data.
Skilled in planning and overseeing local evidence generation (RWE, Phase IV, observational research).
Proficient in developing/adapting scientific communication and medical education materials.
Strong commercial business acumen.
Ability to collaborate effectively across matrix teams and provide clear medical leadership to cross‑functional partners.
Solid understanding of compliance, regulatory requirements, and governance processes.

Leadership Capabilities & Mindset:

Strategic thinker who can anticipate trends and translate insights into clear TA priorities.
Influential leader able to align cross functional stakeholders and build trust with internal/external partners.
Strong people leader who develops others through coaching, feedback, and scientific role modeling.
Drives execution and fosters a results-oriented, evidence-based culture.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity while driving innovation and continuous improvement.
Excellent communicator with the ability to simplify complex scientific concepts for diverse audiences.
High integrity, ethical judgment, and a patient centric mindset guiding all interactions.

Location 

Tokyo (Toranomon Hills)
